candidates.change_summary: Assign owner to msg.sender without payable conversion (keeps type address), changing the assignment expression from payable(msg.sender) to msg.sender.
Assign owner to a fixed address (address(0)) instead of payable(msg.sender), causing owner to become the zero address.
Assign owner to tx.origin instead of msg.sender, so the owner becomes the original transaction sender rather than the immediate caller.
Invert the onlyOwner check to require msg.sender != owner, allowing anyone except the current owner to call owned and change owner.

Replace the owner-only burn so that it can be called by anyone (remove the onlyOwner modifier) which allows any account to burn their own balance and reduce totalSupply, changing totalSupply after burn by non-owners.
Modify burn to subtract from totalSupply twice (double decrement), causing totalSupply to be lower after burn.
Modify burn to decrement totalSupply by zero (replace decrement with no change) so totalSupply remains unchanged after burn.

Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != owner, inverting the check so functions guarded by onlyOwner (including burn) become callable only by non-owners, affecting whether totalSupply can be changed by owner calls.

Change burn to subtract from totalSupply before checking the caller's balance, potentially allowing totalSupply to be decreased even when the subsequent require would revert, altering observable final totalSupply in sequences where low-level behavior differs.
